faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for any person, while performing the duties of a business or
               security guard, to falsely pretend to be a peace officer. The term "pretending" to
               be a peace officer means to:
(1)
Wear or display any uniform, badge, insignia, shield, patch, or pattern that:
a.
Indicates or is intended to indicate to the public that the person is a sworn peace
                  officer;
b.
Contains or includes the words "police" or the words "public safety"; or
c.
Is a colorable imitation of or can be confused with the uniforms of the city police
                  department.
(2)
Have or utilize any vehicle or equipment that:
a.
Displays the words "police," "law enforcement," or "public safety";
b.
Displays any sign, shield, marking, accessory, or insignia that indicates or is intended
                  to indicate to the public that the vehicle or equipment is operated by the city police
                  department or another law enforcement agency; or
c.
Is a colorable imitation of or so similarly marked as to cause confusion with patrol
                  vehicles of the city police department.
(Code 1981, § 21-94; Ord. No. 3739, § 2, 3-4-2002)
